thread:
Mei Chen: Heads-up — Orpheus-v2 int8 landed in staging a few mins ago. Quick smoke shows odd locale-specific regressions: CJK numeral spacing gets collapsed and in mixed Arabic/RTL snippets parentheses/brackets appear flipped. Repro below, tiny but consistent.
Sara V: Can you paste the exact input + outputs you saw?
Mei Chen: Sure — copied from staging endpoint (run: staging-run-2026-03-20-42).
Input:
```
请在 2023 年 10 月 5 日提交报告 (deadline: 10/05/2023)
يرجى تقديم التقرير بحلول (05/10/2023)
```
FP16 (baseline):
```
请在 2023 年 10 月 5 日提交报告 (deadline: 10/05/2023)
يرجى تقديم التقرير بحلول (05/10/2023)
```
INT8 (orpheus-v2, qkernel v1.2):
```
请在2023年10月5日提交报告 )deadline: 10/05/2023(
يرجى تقديم التقرير بحلول )05/10/2023(
```
Notes: you can see the ASCII parentheses are reversed direction in the Arabic line and the spaces between numbers and CJK unit characters are removed in the Chinese line.
Jordan P: Interesting. That smells like either a tokenization boundary change or a detokenization postprocess bug after quant rounding. Any tokenizer/vocab changes in the model import?
Mei Chen: No tokenizer changes — we used the same tokenizer package pinned at v1.14. I ran local tokenization compare: `python ci/token_diff.py --left fp16 --right int8 --sample 1234` and got a handful of boundary diffs around digits. Snippet: `['2023', ' ', '年'] -> ['2023年']` for int8 path.
Kevin L: We changed the quant rounding from HALO->nearest to stochastic rounding for int8 bring-up to reduce avg L2 drift. That could affect embedding lookups near whitespace tokens if quantization nudges logits past a split. I also enabled kernel "fused-kvfold" in qkernel v1.2 for perf.
Sara V: Does the same repro hold if you call the model with `return_tokens=true` and compare token ids? I want to ensure it's tokenization vs detokenize.
Mei Chen: Yes — with `return_tokens` I see the int8 run emits token ids that correspond to a merged token for `2023年` (single token) while fp16 has three tokens [`2023`, ` `, `年`]. So it's upstream of detok: tokenization + sampling path changed.
Anna S: Could this be caused by different top-k/top-p sampling config for staging int8 vs baseline? If logits rounding crosses the boundary probability it could change greedy/argmax boundaries and cause token merges.
Jordan P: Good point. Is this deterministic on beam=1/greedy?
Mei Chen: Repro is deterministic with sampling seeded (seed=42) and also happens under greedy. So it's not sampling randomness; quantization shifts logits enough that different token chosen.
Kevin L: Two quick mitigations: 1) rollback fused-kvfold (cheap revert) 2) try per-tensor asymmetric quant instead of symmetric per-channel. I'll spin a patch build.
infra-bot: deploy:staging-orpheus-v2-int8 (build: 20260320.42) finished — 6 instances healthy.
Sara V: Can we run fast locale test harness across a small devset (zh/ja/ar/he) and capture tokenization deltas + BLEU/chrF diffs? If BLEU delta > 0.5 for zh or >1.0 for ar we should block promote.
Mei Chen: Starting quick run now: `./scripts/run_locale_smoke.sh --run staging-run-2026-03-20-42 --langs zh,ja,ar,he --out s3://redwood-smoke/orpheus-int8-quick.json` — will post results in ~20m.
Jordan P: If Kevin's revert fixes token choices, we should add a unit test that forces quantized logits near boundary to ensure tokenization parity for numeric+unit patterns. Could add a small set: ["2023 年", "10 月", "05 日", "(05/10/2023)"] to regression suite.
Anna S: Agreed — adding those to locale-regressions prompt set. I'll open a PR to add tests.
Kevin L: Patch build queued (no fused-kvfold + asym int8) — job 9876. Will report perf delta; expect ~5% tail latency regression but correctness hopefully restored.
Mei Chen: Thanks. If anyone sees additional oddities (quotes/bracket mirrors in bidi contexts), ping me or drop examples here. Will attach the smoke output when ready. :mag: 
Sara V: Thanks Mei — assigning triage: @Kevin L to build revert, @Jordan P to add deterministic tokenization test, @Anna S to add prompts to regressions set.
Kevin L: on it.
Mei Chen: I'll keep the thread updated with smoke output.
